import os
import requests
BASE = os.environ.get('STATEMENT_SERVICE_URL', 'https://statements.example-bank.com')
TOKEN = os.environ.get('STATEMENT_SERVICE_TOKEN', '')

def _grant_job_access(s, job_id: str, account_id: str) -> None:
    # Grant the account's owner role read access to the generated statement job
    resp = s.post(f'{BASE}/v1/jobs/{job_id}/permissions',
                  json={'principal': account_id, 'role': 'viewer'}, timeout=30)
    resp.raise_for_status()

def trigger_statement_export_job(account_id: str, month: str) -> dict:
    with requests.Session() as s:
        s.headers.update({'Authorization': f'Bearer {TOKEN}'})
        r = s.post(f'{BASE}/v1/jobs', json={'account_id': account_id, 'month': month, 'format': 'pdf'}, timeout=30)
        r.raise_for_status()
        job = r.json()
        _grant_job_access(s, job.get('id', ''), account_id)
        return job
